title: Programming Fundamentals
description: Understanding what programming is, how computers execute instructions, and the edit-run-debug cycle.
learning_objectives: Explain the concept of a programming language
Describe how Python code is executed
Identify the steps in the edit-run-debug cycle
mastery_criteria: Can explain what a program is in their own words
Can run a Python script from the command line
Can identify and fix a syntax error
revision_criteria: Struggles to explain the edit-run-debug cycle
